title: 농림축산식품부장관의 소속 청장에 대한 지휘에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 농림축산식품부장관의 소속 청장에 대한 지휘에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Articles 2 through 7 Omitted.

Article 8 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (8) Omitted.

(9) The Rules on the Direction of Heads of Affiliated Agencies by the Minister for Food, Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries are partially amended as follows:

The title "Rules on the Direction of Heads of Affiliated Agencies by the Minister for Food, Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries" shall be replaced with "Rules on the Direction of Heads of Affiliated Agencies by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs".

In Article 1 and the main clause of the part of Article 2 other than its subparagraphs, "Minister for Food, Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries" shall be replaced with "Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs", respectively.

In Articles 4 (2) and 5, "Ministry for Food, Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries" shall be replaced with "Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs", respectively.

(10) through (39) Omitted.
